alex (support): FYI customer reported repeated function/tool call failures after we ramped model v1.2. Error shows schema validation 422 and wrong tool choice. Pasting snippets from Acme support ticket below.

alex (support): customer payload (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-inference/model-v1.2\",\n  \"input\": \"Summarize invoice and call payment_api with amount and invoice_id\",\n  \"functions\": [{\"name\": \"payment_api\", \"params\": {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"amount\": {\"type\": \"number\"}, \"invoice_id\": {\"type\": \"string\"}}, \"required\": [\"amount\", \"invoice_id\"]}}]
}
```

alex (support): customer got repeated responses where model chose a different tool and passed malformed args, e.g. `{\"tool\": \"billing_lookup\", \"args\": {\"invoice\": 123}}` which fails schema. They saw 15 failures in 2h and rising. Also higher latency (~900ms -> 1.6s tail).

maya (eng-runtime): @alex can you attach the raw request ids and timestamps? Want to pull router traces and model decision logs. Is this only for Acme or other tenants?

alex (support): Sending IDs inline: request_ids: [rq_3A12, rq_3A20, rq_3A27]. All from the same customer org. Last failure at 1912348805.

ops-bot (deploy-bot): Deploy event: model redwood-inference/model-v1.2 promoted to canary=25% at 1912347000 by release-ci (rollout id=rl_2026_03_14_11).

devon (eng-ml): Noted. v1.2 introduced new tool-selection head tweaks (to reduce hallucinated tools). We trained with broader instruction tokens; it's possible the selection distribution shifted — selects billing_lookup instead of payment_api when prompt phrasing ambiguous. Will check policy logits.

maya (eng-runtime): I pulled the routing log for rq_3A27:
```
timestamp=1912348805 router: routed -> model-v1.2 (canary bucket)
model_decision: tool=\"billing_lookup\" (score=0.62) ; payment_api score=0.59
kv_cache: miss
latency_raw: 1620ms
response: {\"tool\":\"billing_lookup\", \"args\":{\"invoice\":123}}
```

maya (eng-runtime): The model's top tool changed; it's selecting a different tool name (billing_lookup) and passing `invoice` as number not string, so JSON schema validation fails. Seems deterministic in these samples.

devon (eng-ml): That aligns with the training change. We thought the higher precision would avoid spurious calls, but looks like edge-case prompts get mapped to older tool name (billing_lookup) that has incompatible arg schema.

jules (product): How bad is impact? Do we have a rate or billing hit? Customer upset and requesting immediate mitigation.

alex (support): Customer reported 15 failed function invocations (422) and several retries from their app which bumped token usage. They asked for a rollback if this can't be fixed quickly.

lin (oncall): Telemetry check: errors spike correlates with canary ramp. 90th percentile failures for function call route jumped from 0.3% to 4.8% for the 25% canary window. CPU/GPU utilisation normal. No infra errors.

devon (eng-ml): Probable root cause: v1.2 changed the canonical tool name mapping for some utterances. Two fixes: 1) re-align tool-name mapping in model (retrain or patch logits mapping), 2) add runtime compatibility shim that maps billing_lookup -> payment_api and coerces args (invoice -> invoice_id string). We can implement shim faster.

maya (eng-runtime): I can push a compatibility layer in the router that rewrites tool name and argument types for the affected canary traffic. We can enable for specific org IDs only. Low-risk change, should take ~1-2 hours to QA.

jules (product): Customer wants rollback while root fix is built. What's the rollback cost and blast radius?

maya (eng-runtime): We can pin Acme's routing policy to model-v1.1 immediately. Route config update should take <10m to propagate. That's safest while devon and I deploy the shim.

devon (eng-ml): Agree. We'll still prepare a patch to v1.2 mapping and follow up with a minor model patch. Estimate 3-4 days for retrain and validation. Shim + routing change is quick.

alex (support): I'll tell the customer we can route them back to v1.1 now and keep them updated on the fix.

ops-bot (deploy-bot): Routing change applied: org=acme-org pinned to redwood-inference/model-v1.1 at 1912349050 by maya.

lin (oncall): After pinning, failure rate for their org dropped to baseline within 2 mins. Confirmed in traces.

jules (product): Thanks team. Action items:
- alex: notify customer + post-mortem summary (ETA 24h)
- maya: push runtime shim and enable for canary orgs (ETA 2h)
- devon: prepare model mapping patch and test plan (ETA 3 days)
- lin: monitor for any further regressions and cost anomalies

alex (support): Notifying now. Will include minimal repro steps and customer logs. :white_check_mark:

maya (eng-runtime): Will post PR link when shim is up.

devon (eng-ml): Adding a note to model rollout checklist to include tool-name mapping smoke tests.

alex (support): customer reply: \"Thanks for the quick response — pinning to v1.1 worked. Please keep us posted on permanent fix.\"

lin (oncall): I'll keep the thread open for 48h and close once metrics stable.

alex (support): closing loop here, marking as escalated->eng and product.
